The '''1948–49 [[Super League Greece|Panhellenic Championship]]''' was the 15th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The clubs that participated were the champions from the 3 founding football associations of the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]]: [[Athens Football Clubs Association|Athens]], [[Piraeus Football Clubs Association|Piraeus]] and [[Macedonia Football Clubs Association|Macedonia]]. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won the championship, due to a better goal ratio than [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]]. The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
